reference: There is juice on the stones after the drop.
sk: Po dopade je na kameňoch trochu šťavy
cz: Po dopadu je na kamenech trochu šťávy
acceptable: There is {|some|a little|a bit of} juice on the {stones|rocks} after the {drop|fall|impact}.
After the {drop|fall|impact} there is {|some|a little|a bit of} juice on the {stones|rocks}.

mistakes.text: There are {some |}{juice|juices} on the stones after the drop.
There is a juice on the stones after the drop.
There is a few juice on the stones after the drop.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „A few“ je pre veci, ktoré sa dajú spočítať. Pri „juice“ patrí „a little“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „A few“ je pro věci, které se dají spočítat. U „juice“ patří „a little“.

mistakes.text: There is little juice on the stones after the drop.
After the drop is {some |}juice on the stones.

source_issues: Native sentences add 'trochu' (a little/some); translations with and without it accepted.
